name: Decision Intelligence Audit
description:
When a critical product, AI, or delivery decision begins to stall, alignment breaks down fast. Teams move in different directions, assumptions go unchallenged, and risk becomes harder to see. 

Over 72 hours, I work with your team to uncover friction, challenge assumptions, and evaluate the evidence behind the decision  delivering a structured, decision-ready report with clear risks, opportunities, and next steps.
imageAlt: Strategy session around a table with documents and laptops

name: Heuristic Evaluation
tagline: What your UX is really costing you.
description:
Poor UX rarely appears as a single problem. It shows up as slower adoption, inconsistent behaviour, support overhead, abandoned journeys, and growing delivery complexity. 

In 72 hours, I conduct a structured heuristic evaluation of your product and deliver a commercially-framed report that connects usability friction directly to customer trust, operational risk, and missed growth opportunities.
